en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Notes, documents and tasks, all local. No subscription, no telemetry.
en-US.longDescription:
Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
en-US.name: Tisty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tisty 1.44.0
Share in every language, and what is someone else's stays theirs
- A document in several languages is shared whole: whoever you give the edit link can edit every language, and Change the edit link changes it for all of them at once.
- Opening a shared link brings every language of the document, and opens the one your Tisty speaks.
- Sync brings in apart a newer version of any language someone else sent, so nothing of yours is overwritten.
- When you share, you choose which of your languages go, and the ones you leave out stay out on every later Sync.
- The owner changes the edit link in one press, and whoever held the old one is told why.
- A shared document names everyone who edited it, each signed with their own key.
- A copy that reached you to read stays a copy: it is never sent again, not even as a new document.
- Someone else's writing stays theirs when you copy, duplicate, translate, import or share it.
- A Tisty is one person's: another person's history is never merged into yours, and a new computer has to sign what it writes before its history comes in.
- Documents go out as Markdown one at a time. Export everything for Tisty still takes them all.
- A Markdown file opened from disk shows its first line as you wrote it.
- The task list and a task can name the assistant that worked on it, or just say it was an agent.
What's Changed
- fix(guide): the edge keeps the guide a day until a release purges it,… by @rgdevment in #649
- feat(sharing): a share edited from several Tistys names its editors, signed, and keeps to newer contracts by @rgdevment in #651
- feat(agents): the task list and the inside of a task can each name the assistant or just say «by an agent» by @rgdevment in #650
- feat(sharing): a copy from a read link goes only as a new document, after a notice, naming what it is based on by @rgdevment in #652
- feat(sharing): the owner changes the edit link in one press, and whoever held the old one is told so by @rgdevment in #653
- fix(viewer): a Markdown file opened from disk shows its first line as written, not as a title by @rgdevment in #654
- feat(sharing): Folio's private address is the one Folio signs in its domains branch, asked every two days by @rgdevment in #655
- feat(sharing): the Share dialog ticks each language of one's own, and a Sync keeps the ones left out by @rgdevment in #656
- fix(docs): documents leave as Markdown one at a time, so the copies of others never go out in bulk by @rgdevment in #657
- fix(sharing): a copy of someone else's writing stays theirs, even unnamed, signed over or not marked as a copy by @rgdevment in #658
- fix(sync): a Tisty is one person's, so another person's history is never stitched in nor speaks for it by @rgdevment in #659
- fix(sharing): someone else's pages, versions, translations and kept files stay theirs when copied or shared by @rgdevment in #660
- fix(sync): a machine new to this Tisty must sign what it writes, so nobody slips in an unsigned history by @rgdevment in #661
- feat(sharing): each language shared to edit has its own token, sealed in its anchor's map (contract 1.8.0) by @rgdevment in #662
- feat(sharing): opening a link brings every language, and its edit link opens each language's token by @rgdevment in #663
- docs: the 1.44.0 news tell of sharing in every language and of what stays someone else's by @rgdevment in #665
- docs: what a person reads is read against 1.44.0, with one person's Tisty and a token per language by @rgdevment in #666
Full Changelog: v1.43.1...v1.44.0

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Notas, documentos y tareas, todo local. Sin suscripción ni telemetría.
es.longDescription:
Tisty guarda lo que sabes en tu propio equipo: notas, documentos y tareas, en archivos
Markdown que puedes leer sin él. Todo lo que haces se escribe en un registro que solo
crece, así que nada se pierde por accidente y un cambio se puede deshacer; borrar para
siempre es el único paso que no. Sin cuenta, sin
suscripción, sin telemetría y sin servidor. La sincronización, si la quieres, pasa por
una carpeta que tus equipos ya alcanzan, y un asistente entra por una puerta que abres tú.
es.name: Tisty
